l01.text: [excited] We are in Madrid! And this is our hotel.

l02.text: [deadpan] It has a spinning door. I like it.

l05.text: [warm] Good evening! Welcome to Hotel Pato Real. How can I help you?

e1.text: [friendly] A reservation means you booked a room before.

l07.text: [friendly] Of course. What is your name, please?

l08.text: [cheerful] Sofia. And my friend is Gus.

l09.text: [thoughtful] ...Yes. A room for two nights. And... one goose?

l11.text: [confused] The booking says: Gus Goose, plus twenty burgers.

l14.text: [politely] Can I have a key card, please?

e2.text: [friendly] A key card opens the door of your room.

l15.text: [warm] Here you are. Two key cards. Room four-oh-four.

l16.text: [shocked] Gus! Did you eat the key card?!

e3.text: [friendly] Breakfast is the first meal of the day.

l20.text: [cheerful] Breakfast is from seven to ten, in the restaurant.

l23.text: [deadpan] I will be there at six.

l24.text: [friendly] Follow me, please! The lift is here.

l25.text: [curious] A lift? Is it a flying machine?

l26.text: [laughing] No, Gus. A lift is an elevator. It goes up.

l28.text: [flatly] It is very hot in here.

l29.text: [concerned] Oh no. The air conditioning doesn't work.

e5.text: [friendly] Air conditioning is the machine that makes the room cool.

l31.text: [laughing] Gus is not an air conditioner!

l32.text: [apologetic] Sorry, sorry! One minute... Done! Now it is cool.

l33.text: [curious] Thank you! What's the Wi-Fi password?

e4.text: [friendly] A password is a secret word. You need it for the internet.

l34.text: [friendly] It is: burgers, one, two, three.

l36.text: [yawns] Gus... it is six o'clock. Breakfast is at seven.

l38.text: [shocked] Gus! You ate the whole buffet!

l39.text: [exasperated] Sir... that was breakfast for fifty guests.

l41.text: [politely] Excuse me. What time is check-out?

e6.text: [friendly] Check-out is when you leave the hotel and give back the key.

l45.text: [deadpan] Then I will live in the lobby.

l46.text: [smiling] Or you can pay the bill, sir.

l48.text: [cheerful] Let's practice! Say it with me!

r2.text: Can I have a key card, please?

q01.text: [excited] Quick quiz! What did Gus eat for breakfast?

q02.text: A: One toast. Or B: The whole buffet.

l49.text: [curious] Where do YOU want to stay? A hotel, a hostel, or a tent? Write it in the comments!

l51.text: [deadpan] Bye bye. I am not checking out.
